title: Text change status names a sequence-ledger freeze before the verification_ignored_paths repair
description: Text change status names a sequence-ledger freeze before the verification_ignored_paths repair
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-change-034 requires text change status to name its next action matching JSON status, and REQ-change-138 orders JSON next_action as a sequence-ledger freeze, then a verification_ignored_paths refusal; text named the policy repair first (#937)
acceptance_criteria: with a frozen sequence ledger and an invalid verification_ignored_paths entry, text change status Next names the freeze, as JSON next_action does; without a freeze, text Next still names the verification_ignored_paths repair
